diagnostics: cost and exposed memory tokens per arm
invalid rows and budget stops per arm
analysis_plan.interpretation: quality_evidence stays false. recall_evidence joins the CLI's built-in default only if the primary favors the treatment at p < 0.05 and exact match is not lower; a null or negative primary keeps it off
analysis_plan.multiplicity: one primary comparison; everything else is descriptive
analysis_plan.primary_estimand: paired difference in the share of cases where the model opened (KgContext or host auto_context) at least one gold-session memory: tinykg_jev_order_atomic minus tinykg_jev_recall_atomic
analysis_plan.primary_population: cases where both compared rows are evaluator-ready; unmatched or invalid rows are reported and never imputed
analysis_plan.primary_test: two-sided exact McNemar over matched pairs at alpha 0.05 (jev_recall_order_pilot.py analyze)
secondary: paired normalized exact match, same test
no_memory exact match as a sanity floor

arms.no_memory: protocol cold-start control; reported, never tested
arms.tinykg_jev_order_atomic: treatment: the control plus the judged KgRecall row order (METACODES_JEV_DECISIONS=scoped_recall,recall_evidence)
arms.tinykg_jev_recall_atomic: control: atomic (turn-level) TinyKG store, TinyKG tools kept, Jev advisory on scoped_recall only

system_one.upstream: Kunshan self-hosted service (origin bound by sha256 in each run receipt)

population.overlap_note: The 2026-09 tool-using LongMemEval pilots drew 90 cases by a rule documented as yielding 193 eligible cases; this rule yields 187 under the current adapter and the earlier list was not kept, so overlap with those pilots is possible. No parameter of the tested policy was chosen on these cases.
population.rule: scripts/eval/jev_recall_order_pilot.py cases: holdout positions 200-499; drop single-session-preference; keep a case when at least one gold answer has at most four whitespace-separated words

question: Does the judged KgRecall row order (Jev surface recall_evidence, question set metacodes.jev.recall-order.v1) add to the System-One recall gate when the model recalls atomic memories itself?

shards.authority: every shard's max_total_cost_usd is 15.00 minus the provider-estimated cost already committed by earlier shards; the cumulative cap never exceeds the user authorization
shards.calibration: shard 0 is 4 cases at max_rollout_cost_usd 0.60 to measure per-rollout cost; later shards fix max_rollout_cost_usd from it and are sized to the remaining authority
shards.continuation: decided from costs alone; outcomes are not inspected until the last shard has run
shards.procedure: contiguous runs of the case list from position 0, in order; each shard is filtered from the upstream file (jev_recall_order_pilot.py shard), adapted with this execution.json, and run by memory_agent_runtime_pilot.py with its own budget journal
shards.stop: when the case list is exhausted or the remaining authority cannot cover a shard of at least two cases
